2] This petition has been filed by the petitioner under Section 528 of B.N.S.S. for relaxation of condition no.iv of bail order dated 22.10.2019 passed by this Court in MCRC.No.40213/2019 in connection with Crime No.501 of 2014 registered at police station Aerodrome for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468 & 471 of IPC, while granting the bail, has also imposed condition (iv)that the applicant shall report and mark his attendance in the concerned police station on second Sunday of every month between 10. 00 am to 12.00 noon.
3] Counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is religiously attending the concerned police station as directed by this Court, and the conclusion of the trial is likely to take a sufficient long time.

It is further submitted that the applicant is expected to travel to Tirupati in the morning of 11th December, 2025, which happens to be the second Sunday of the month, and thus, the aforesaid condition may be dispensed with.
4] Counsel for the State has opposed the prayer.
